deck_title: Kirchhoff-Fresnel wavefront obliquity factor vs naive isotropic Huygens leakage rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Augustin-Jean Fresnel (1818) & Gustav Kirchhoff (1882) cardioid wavefront obliquity factor (K(theta) = 0.5*(1 + cos(theta)) = 1/(1+u), combining monopole pressure and dipole normal-gradient boundary terms to annihilate backward waves K(180 deg) = 0 and lock secondary wavelet amplitude at A/A_exact = 1.0000x across all 17 obliquity stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 leaking stations) versus naive isotropic Huygens spherical wavelets (K = 1.0, which radiates equally backward and sideways, inflating wavelet amplitude as 1/K = 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at theta=90 deg u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-patch Helmholtz-Kirchhoff Green boundary integration.
